name: International online strugglers
action: Fix failed online and international payments (clear guidance, easy retry), then reward the first successful online purchase.

name: Occasional low-activity users
action: Send a simple 'use your card this week' nudge right after each top-up; main pool for the Flip-In win-back list.

name: OXXO-anchored regulars
action: Biggest room to move spend outside OXXO: cash-back at nearby pharmacies and grocers, sent right after an OXXO cash-in.

name: Virtual-card digital natives
action: Grow online spend: add the card to digital wallets and subscriptions, and cut declined payments.

name: Balance spenders (no top-up)
action: Top-up reminders and low-balance alerts so the card stays usable, paired with a non-OXXO purchase offer.

name: Cash-loaded core spenders
action: Reward the routine purchases they already make outside OXXO; make cash top-ups easier so money stays on Spin.

name: SPEI-funded power users
action: Protect with loyalty rewards and higher limits; little OXXO share left to move, so low Flip-Out priority.
